author: ImRaging
body:
I think the trails are really cool, and have personally chosen them over badges. However, I would like if more particles came out, with not such a big radius of particles flying everywhere. I just think it'll look a bit better, imo.

I recognise that many people like trails, but might not like the fact that they can get spotted easily when trying to be sneaky or whatever. To fix this, would it be possible to have a setting for the amount of particles that bounce around? Maybe 4 options like '5, 10, 15, 20' (as in e.g. twenty particles)? 

I dunno, just think it would make the trails a bit cooler to have.
